dedupe_keys.name: samoa bureau of statistics 2021 population and housing census district profiles with household electricity meters drinking water source rainwater tanks toilet type mobile phones and internet tabulated for each of 51 districts and their villages

description: The Samoa Bureau of Statistics released a profile of each of the 51 electoral districts from the November 2021 Population and Housing Census, one PDF per district, written in Samoan. Section 4 describes households and their services: whether they have electricity and which meter type they use, the main source of drinking water, whether they own rainwater tanks, toilet type, mobile phones, internet access, television and vehicles. Section 5 repeats key tables for each village in the district, such as toilet type and water tanks per village. Coverage is national through the full set of profiles; in Aana Alofi 1, for example, 88 percent of households drink metered piped water and a third have a water tank. The census questionnaire is appended, and it also asks about tank size and floor material. Format and access: free PDF downloads, no registration; a census dashboard shows population by village. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: text is in Samoan and the tables are inside PDFs; the 2011 and 2006 census entries in the microdata catalogue show metadata only. Simulation uses: village level water tank and piped water shares for drought and cyclone planning, and toilet types for sanitation services. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub, which lists Samoa census databases.
